# SQLite 3.54.1 (amalgamation)

`sqlite3.c` and `sqlite3.h`, unchanged, from
https://sqlite.org/2026/sqlite-amalgamation-3540100.zip
(SHA3-256 `92281c86e2957f9b9305890f9ac04204caa7b677cc868dc326d942689df28e30`,
as published on https://sqlite.org/download.html).

SQLite is in the public domain: https://sqlite.org/copyright.html

Vendored so the reuse store builds without a system SQLite. To update: download
the new amalgamation, check its SHA3-256 against sqlite.org's download page,
replace the two files, and update this README.
